title: Animation track with UpdateMode set to Discrete are not reset by the Deterministic option
body: ### Tested versions Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.steam.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 ### System information Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.steam.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 ### Issue description https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9123a42e-d40e-4e6f-9472-73e9ed0e5146 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/479faddf-5a9a-4e66-94fe-a416951361b0 I am developing my action game, and I want the current attack action to be interrupted when the character is hit. Then I found that if I call animationplayer.play("hurt") to interrupt the current animation and play a new one while the current animation is playing, if the attack hitbox is still active when it is interrupted, the attack hitbox will remain active. After my tests, I suspect that the deterministic property of AnimationPlayer only performs the RESET operation when the animation is completely finished, that is, when the animation_finished event is triggered. If this is the case, there is a big problem: the animation properties cannot be properly cleaned up and reset when the action is interrupted. ### Steps to reproduce https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/34e263fd-86ae-4650-9605-77b345e4a8e2 ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [animation_reset.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23697028/animation_reset.zip)
